# Wild Canvas Glamping Escapes, Waitomo, New Zealand

> Wild Canvas is a luxury glamping property in Waitomo, Waikato, New Zealand, with two private safari tents, each on its own hilltop on a working family farm. It was the first glamping property in New Zealand to hold a 5-Star Qualmark Gold rating. Family-owned and operated by Emily and Benjamin Scott since 2017.

Each tent is booked exclusively: no shared spaces and no other guests nearby. The tents are about 1 km apart on a 700-hectare, third-generation family farm, minutes from the Waitomo Glowworm Caves.

- Website: https://wildcanvas.nz
- Book direct: https://wildcanvas.nz/booking
- Email: hello@wildcanvas.nz
- Phone: +64 21 166 6248
- Address: Mangarino Road, Hangatiki, Waitomo, Waikato, New Zealand
- Drive times: about 2.5 hours from Auckland, 1 hour from Hamilton, 2 hours from Tauranga, 2 hours from Taupō, 6 hours from Wellington
- Recognition: 5-Star Qualmark Gold; Airbnb Best Design Stay Award 2023; featured in NZ Herald, Kia Ora Magazine, Life & Leisure and Fashion Quarterly
- Reviews: rated 5.0 from 200+ Google reviews

## The tents

### Kōwhai Tent (couples, adults only)
- Guests: up to 2 adults. No children.
- Price: NZD $590 per night, every night of the week
- One queen bedroom with an ensuite (rain shower)
- Twin outdoor claw-foot baths overlooking the valley, indoor wood fireplace, outdoor kitchen with wood-fired pizza oven, BBQ and gas hob, private firepit, movie projector
- Off-grid (solar and battery); lanterns and power packs provided; 4G coverage
- Access: steep unsealed track, 4WD or AWD needed. Guests can borrow the property's Suzuki Jimny free of charge. 120 m uphill walk from the carpark to the tent.
- Check-in from 2pm, check-out by 11am
- Suits: anniversaries, honeymoons, proposals, birthdays, romantic weekends
- Page: https://wildcanvas.nz/kowhai
- Book: https://wildcanvas.nz/booking?tent=kowhai

### Pōhutukawa Tent (families and groups)
- Guests: up to 8. Children welcome.
- Price: NZD $1,635 per night for the whole tent
- Four queen bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, underfloor heating
- Cedar hot tub, double-sided stone fireplace, full indoor kitchen, outdoor pizza oven and BBQ, 360° hilltop views
- Full power from an off-grid solar system; appliances work as they would at home
- Check-in from 2pm, check-out by 10am
- Suits: family holidays, friends' getaways, milestone birthdays, multi-generational trips
- Page: https://wildcanvas.nz/pohutukawa
- Book: https://wildcanvas.nz/booking?tent=pohutukawa

## Booking terms
- Minimum stay: 1 night, except 22 December to 5 January (3 nights)
- Payment: Kōwhai Tent paid in full at booking. Pōhutukawa Tent can be paid in full or with a 30% deposit, with the balance charged automatically 30 days before check-in.
- Cancellation: 2+ weeks' notice, full refund; less than 2 weeks, 50% refund; less than 1 week, no refund. Date changes are treated as cancellations.
- No pets (working farm)

## Included with every stay
- Kōwhai Tent: organic eggs and milk, butter, fresh homemade bread, s'mores kit, tea, coffee, condiments, premium toiletries
- Pōhutukawa Tent: bottle of NZ wine, milk, yoghurt, butter, eggs, cereal, s'mores kit, tea, coffee, condiments

## Optional extras
- Catering waiting at the tent: antipasto platter (NZD $89), ready-to-cook wood-fired pizzas ($44 each), ready-to-cook gourmet dinner for two ($170), Champagne
- In-tent massages (subject to therapist availability)
- Pōhutukawa Tent only: private chef, cocktail bartender, clay target shooting, pottery class, yoga session
- Details: https://wildcanvas.nz/experiences

## Gift vouchers
Vouchers for a Kōwhai night ($590), the Ultimate Kōwhai night with dinner, massages and Champagne ($1,159), and a Pōhutukawa night ($1,635). Emailed instantly, valid for 2 years. https://wildcanvas.nz/gift

## Nearby
Waitomo Glowworm Caves, Lost World Adventures, Ruakuri Walk, Marokopa Falls, Mangapohue Natural Bridge, the Ōtorohanga Kiwi House, Waitomo Caves Zipline, and day trips to Hobbiton and the Hairy Feet Hobbit film location. Guide: https://wildcanvas.nz/waitomo
